mcp.name: MCP
mcp.description: Lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code work with your collection, and connects external MCP servers.

allow_writes.label: Let MCP clients make changes
allow_writes.description: Off: assistants can only read (list decks, search, read notes).

server.heading: Use from Claude
server.intro: AI assistants that speak MCP start this app's server and work with this collection. Every change they make is an ordinary step you can undo.
server.db_hint: Replace the path with your collection file.

client.heading: External MCP servers
client.intro: Servers whose tools the app's AI features may use. Each call is shown; tools that change things ask first.
client.name: Name
client.confirm_add: This app will start the following program whenever its AI features use this server: {command}. Only continue if you trust it.
client.confirm_approve: This server came from outside (a restored backup, for example) and has never been approved. Approving lets the app start: {command}. Only continue if you trust it.

validation.mcp_server: Check the server: it needs a name, and a command (or an http(s) URL).

not_found.mcp_server: That MCP server no longer exists.

conflict.mcp_server_name: Another MCP server already has this name.

permission.mcp_read_only: MCP clients may only read: changes are turned off.
